points.why: It explicitly separates power from reach, calling culture change high-power but low near-term reach, and says the strongest lever isn't the whole analysis.
It says high leverage isn't the same as the right next step and defends the checklist as an honestly labeled stopgap.

It recommends doing both with the checklist as a labeled stopgap, but it doesn't tie each intervention to the specific handoff link it changes; it only suggests reviewing incidents to find the driver.
